title: The Torn Page Backed with Tissue
youtube_title: The Torn Page Backed with Tissue | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Opal notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a torn page backed with soft tissue so the book could finish. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Opal does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
